# Rank Kiwi: Viral Outlier Research for Instagram & YouTube

> Rank Kiwi is a lightweight, privacy-first browser extension for creator research. It allows creators, social media managers, and editors to analyze Instagram profiles and YouTube channels, benchmark engagement against median baseline performance, and instantly surface high-performing viral outlier posts and videos.

## Core Capabilities

- [Instagram Reels Outlier Discovery](https://rankkiwi.com/instagram-analytics/): Scans reels and posts across any Instagram profile, computes view-to-median Outlier Scores, and highlights anomaly content.
- [YouTube Outlier Discovery](https://rankkiwi.com/youtube-analytics/): Analyzes channel video catalogs and YouTube Shorts, filtering top 1% breakout uploads.
- [Median Benchmark Scoring](https://rankkiwi.com/outlier-score/): Calculates non-skewed median metrics (1.0× typical, 3.2× strong, 5.8×+ viral outlier) to eliminate distortion from one-off viral hits.
- [Creator Content Research](https://rankkiwi.com/creator-content-research/): Reverse-engineers competitor content strategies, packaging patterns, and high-frequency topics.
- [Data Export](https://rankkiwi.com/docs/exports/): One-click export of video URLs, hooks, view counts, like ratios, and outlier scores to CSV, JSON, and Google Sheets.
- [Client-Side Privacy](https://rankkiwi.com/privacy/): 100% in-browser processing in the Chrome sandbox with zero database retention, zero external API tracking, and no account or password required.

## Research & Editorial Benchmarks

- [Rank Kiwi Research Hub](https://rankkiwi.com/research/): Original quantitative research into content performance and distribution outliers.
- [Research Methodology](https://rankkiwi.com/research/methodology/): Data transparency standards, derived value rules, and editorial principles.
- [Instagram Reels vs Carousels Benchmark](https://rankkiwi.com/research/instagram-reels-vs-carousels/): Analysis of Buffer's 4M+ post study on the reach vs engagement trade-off.
- [Instagram Views by Account Size](https://rankkiwi.com/research/instagram-views-by-account-size/): Socialinsider benchmark evaluating average view scaling across 5 follower tiers.
- [One Video Doesn't Tell You How Good a Creator Is](https://rankkiwi.com/research/one-video-is-not-a-channel/): vidIQ study of 448K channels showing 10.82× spread between median first video and best of first 10.
- [YouTube Upload Frequency Analysis](https://rankkiwi.com/research/youtube-upload-frequency/): vidIQ study of 10.2M channels analyzing upload cadence vs median growth rates.
- [YouTube Channel Size Rarity Census](https://rankkiwi.com/research/youtube-channel-size/): 61.2M channel census detailing milestone rarity (0.13% at 1M+ subs).
